messages:
anna: Quick alert - Pages onboarding sample fails in ESM envs after we switched to an exports wildcard.

rohit: What error are users seeing?

anna: Runtime: "TypeError: default is not a function" when importing `import { RetryPolicy } from 'redwood-sdk'`. Editor: "Could not find declaration file for 'redwood-sdk'".

maya: Wildcard exports (`"./*": "./dist/*"`) don't forward types and our ESM bundle ended up as default-only. CJS had named exports so local tests passed.

rohit: Short term fix: add top-level \"types\": \"dist/index.d.ts\" and explicit \".\" conditional export mapping with import/require.

anna: I patched the sample to `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'; const { RetryPolicy } = Redwood.default || Redwood;` so onboarding works on Pages. Messy but unblocks customers.

builder-bot: created issue #4382 and draft PR by rohit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1301 \u2014 adds named exports to ESM output and types field.

maya: Long term: add ESM named-exports interop in rollup, CI lint to forbid `require()` in samples, and a smoke test against an ESM runtime (Pages/Deno/Bun).

rohit: I'll land the PR and update the onboarding template + docs note about ESM/CJS parity.

anna: Thanks — I'll notify CS and update the internal checklist once PR merges. :thumbsup:
